output.content: This creamy chicken potato soup recipe makes 6 hearty servings in 1-pot, with each portion (about 1.5 cups each) rocking peas, carrots, bits of cooked chicken thigh and (of course) chunks of perfectly tender Yukon gold potatoes. The potatoes add a lovely heartiness to the soup and, after the veggies + chicken simmer to to perfection in the broth, you scoop out some of those lovely buttery potatoes and blend them with some Greek yogurt.
